Ten-week programme aimed at penultimate-year law students; firm's own early careers page confirms applications open 9:00am AEST 9 June 2027 and close 11:59pm AEST 11 July 2027, with interviews from the first week of August 2027 and offers from 8 September 2027.
Firm's careers page states applications are currently closed and will open in June for the 2027/28 seasonal clerkship program, but no exact 2027 open/close dates are published yet, so dates are null.
